records.command:
gh repo view DanIrl7/first-light --json name,description,url,primaryLanguage,isPrivate,updatedAt -q '"REPO: " + .name + " | " + (.description // "(no description)") + " | " + (.primaryLanguage.name // "?") + " | private=" + (.isPrivate|tostring) + " | updated " + .updatedAt' 2>&1; echo "---"; gh issue view 3 --repo vxu-labs/dip --json number,title,state,author,url,createdAt,closedAt,body -q '"ISSUE #" + (.number|tostring) + " [" + .state + "] " + .title + "
by " + .author.login + " on " + .createdAt + (if .closedAt then " closed " + .closedAt else "" end) + "
" + .url + "

" + (.body // "")' 2>&1 | head -80
